text: {"observations":"Three sparse broadband clicks at about 0, 0.8 and 1.75 s (light switch); sustained low-frequency-weighted noise from about 4.5 to 7 s (boiling water); steady tonal lines near 750 Hz and 4.1 kHz decaying from about 9.1 to 11 s (doorbell chime); regular, evenly spaced clicks from about 11.5 to 13.5 s (clock ticking).
